overview: Black answers 2.Nf3 with the early knight jump 2...Ne4. White usually gets a comfortable position by chasing the knight with Nd2 or by playing c4 and Nbd2, while Black goes for exchanges to relieve the position. Little is known about this rare line and I am reasoning mostly from the moves.
